title: Texas steps in as surrogate delivers baby, despite intended parents seeking abortion
summary: California parents wanted to end a surrogate pregnancy when doctors diagnosed the baby with a severe heart defect at 20 weeks. The surrogate refused and went to Texas, where the state has now stepped in. The baby was born on Wednesday. Jason Allen reports.

title: Americans are eating less produce amid cyclospora outbreak, CBS News poll finds
summary: Amid the outbreak of cyclospora, a CBS News poll finds 40% of Americans say they are buying or eating less produce. Nearly half of those polled say they have little or no confidence in the FDA to deal with the outbreak. Carter Evans reports.

title: How Trump admin cuts have compromised food safety
summary: Since May, more than 11,000 cases of illness caused by the parasite cyclospora have been reported in 41 states. This comes after the Trump administration drastically cut FDA and CDC staff, prompting one expert to call this summer's outbreaks "a national wake-up call."

title: Confusion around cyclosporiasis outbreak as RFK Jr. tries to calm concerns
summary: The Centers for Disease Control said the cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce has expanded to four more states and sickened thousands. In the weeks following the initial reports, some consumers expressed confusion about what's safe and what's not. Ali Bauman has more details.

title: Taylor Farms reportedly shut down Mexican processing facility linked to cyclospora outbreak
summary: U.S. health officials said they are investigating an additional outbreak of cyclospora, but do not know its source. Plus, Taylor Farms has reportedly shut down the plant where lettuce is suspected to have started the initial outbreak that has sickened thousands in at least 41 states. Carter Evans reports.

title: Florida pastor sues OpenAI over dangerous medical advice he got from ChatGPT
summary: A pastor in Florida is suing OpenAI after he used ChatGPT for medical advice and received suggestions that he claims caused him to delay necessary treatment. Jo Ling Kent reports.

summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. made his first public comment on the growing cyclosporiasis outbreak on Tuesday, declaring it under control and denying that cutbacks to monitoring activities have hurt U.S. food safety. Carter Evans reports.

title: Melinda French Gates: "It took me three doctors to really diagnose" my perimenopause symptoms
summary: Melinda French Gates recalled to Norah O'Donnell on "Healthful" that she started getting perimenopause symptoms in her early 40s. "I kind of couldn't believe it because I just finished having my last child in my late 30s," French Gates said. French Gates added it took three doctors to diagnose her symptoms and to get her the right treatments.

title: FDA says it's still investigating Taylor Farms for cyclospora after false positive

title: Taylor Farms recalls iceberg lettuce after link to diarrhea-causing parasite

Taco Bell said it removed the lettuce, and Taylor Farms voluntarily recalled their impacted product.

title: FDA identifies potential culprit in cyclosporiasis outbreak as illness spreads nationwide
summary: Authorities have traced the cyclosporiasis outbreak to Mexican-grown lettuce delivered to Taco Bell by Taylor Farms. Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

title: CDC looking into several items potentially linked to cyclospora parasite
